description: Production-oriented WPF desktop project and item templates built with Vertical Slice Architecture: CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, WPF-UI (Fluent), an in-process CQRS dispatcher with validation and exception pipelines, FluentValidation, and either EF Core or a Refit API client.
releaseNotes: v1.0.0 introduces the WPF Vertical Slice desktop app template and the matching feature scaffolding template for .NET 10.
title: Net Vertical Slice WPF Templates
